attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 27 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page, and it prints no hymn. Where doxologia.ro gave only the name, saint.gr gives a life of six sentences, which the paragraph added to the folder's life reports; it is the first thing this folder knows about him beyond the bare commemoration.
